prose.title: The starting point
prose.intro: No website of its own, several domains bought and none of them showing anything, and the Google Business Profile without organized photos or the right categories.

items.title: A static website, with no framework and no dependencies
items.text: On Cloudflare Pages and deployed from GitHub on every push: home page, one page per service (six), a blog and the legal pages, plus a custom error page.

items.title: Local SEO
items.text: One page per service, so Google shows the right one to someone searching for «limpieza de comunidades» (apartment-building cleaning) instead of the home page; structured data (LocalBusiness, Service, BreadcrumbList, BlogPosting); a sitemap and the site registered in Search Console.

items.title: The form, with no third parties in the browser
items.text: A Pages Function that sends through Resend and only reports success once the server confirms it, with validation and spam filters on the server and no captcha. Next to it, WhatsApp and a sticky call-and-message bar on mobile.

items.title: Strict CSP and not a single cookie
text: ) and cookie-free analytics, so no banner either: asking permission for something that doesn't happen would be wrong as well as annoying.

items.title: The domains, sorted out
items.text: One main domain and the rest redirecting to it, each with its certificate, without moving the domain or the email away from their provider.

items.title: Google Business Profile
items.text: An initial audit, a rewritten description, a complete service catalog, wider service areas and posts that link to the website.

items.title: After delivery
items.text: Monthly upkeep of the profile, one blog article a month, updates and backups.

figureList.title: Measured
note: Lighthouse on mobile, on the home page and two service pages:

note.strong: performance 95–96, and 100 for accessibility, best practices and SEO

columns.title: Who owns what
columns.text: The client owns the domains, the hosting and the email, the Google Business Profile and Search Console. I'm the technical manager, not the owner.

columns.title: What isn't shown
columns.text: What it cost, and the numbers from its Google Business Profile: views, calls and searches are its business data. What's measured here is the website.
